hero.title: Xenebia builds his own engines, worlds, and tools.
hero.lede: A solo dev workshop: handcrafted 3D engines, RPGs, speedrun tooling, mods and bots. Everything here is code that's been written, broken, fixed, and shipped again.

kernelError.short: A fully handcrafted 3D FPS engine, no third-party game engine — built brick by brick in Python/PyGame/OpenGL.
kernelError.detail: Extended with RPG systems: XP and leveling, enemies driven by a finite-state machine with wave management, a skill tree, and dash / double-jump mechanics. No third-party engine — 3D rendering, the game loop, and physics are all handwritten.

rpgPixel.short: A pixel-art hack'n'slash inspired by Greek mythology, separate from Le Dernier Tic.
rpgPixel.detail: Erebos, the resurrected God of Darkness, faces the Four Primordial Deities (Gaia, Tartarus, Nyx, Eros) across open-world realms. Movement system in place, a four-variant sword combo, a debug menu with toggleable textures, and adjustable screen pixelation. Character: a small witch/reaper with a tall pointed hat, black silhouette, red-trimmed cape.

dernierTic.short: A steampunk time-manipulation RPG set between the cities of Mécanovie and Horlogia.
dernierTic.detail: Four confirmed time powers: slow-down, freeze, location-anchored time jumps, and a visual rewind on death. The opening menu is already prototyped, with a dolly-zoom effect and a LOADING → ZOOM → BLACKOUT → DONE state machine for the fade to black.

godot.short: A medieval-fantasy 3D RPG with cel-shaded rendering, in the spirit of Zelda and Leadale.
godot.detail: Several scene and script errors have already been resolved along the way, including a corrupted World.tscn and mismatched node names.

leaderboard.short: Speedrun leaderboard syncing by world, level, sub-level, and category.
leaderboard.detail: Local SQLite database, with selection by world (Amethyst Ascent, Gusty Glades, Tombstone Tower, Neon Nexus, Challenge Levels), category (Any%, All Leaves, All Berries, Fullberry) and data type. Planned: smart syncing that checks what's already stored before downloading, an offline mode, cancel-mid-sync, and remembering the last settings used.

launcher.short: A GUI to gather and launch all personal projects from one place.
launcher.detail: Each project can either open its folder or launch directly, whichever fits. Meant to cover every known project from the start: Godot 3D RPG, KERNEL_ERROR, Image Studio, Le Dernier Tic, Leaderboard Sync, the Minecraft horror mod, the WhatsApp bot.

imageStudio.short: An image editor combining an AI upscaler with retro filter / pixelation tools.
imageStudio.detail: Seven modules (main, app, menu, sidebar, filters, upscaler, theme), with undo/redo, zoom, background processing for upscaling, and a native menu bar. Packaged as a Windows executable via PyInstaller and Inno Setup. The public GitHub repo has its own detailed README — see the GitHub Repos section below.

minecraft.short: A complete horror mod with a quest and story, on the Fabric loader.
minecraft.detail: Targets version 1.20.1 rather than the latest release. Chosen theme: a haunted forest where an entity stalks the player.

whatsapp.short: A bot meant to react to commands sent over WhatsApp.
whatsapp.detail: Built with whatsapp-web.js and qrcode-terminal. Project structure: botwhatsapp.js, package.json, .wwebjs_auth / .wwebjs_cache folders.

signalPerdu.desc: A horror game, still in development.

imageStudio.lede: Desktop image editor — AI upscaling, retro filters and pixelation, in one tool.
imageStudio.li1: AI upscaling ×2 / ×4 (Real-ESRGAN if available, otherwise Pillow Lanczos)
imageStudio.li2: Adjustable pixelation via slider, live rendering
imageStudio.li3: 7 retro filters: Game Boy, Game Boy Pocket, Game Boy Color, NES, SNES, Mega Drive, CRT

radarScan.lede: A graphical network scanner in Java, to be compiled and used within legal bounds.
radarScan.li1: Detects devices on the local network (IP ping)
radarScan.li2: Wi-Fi scanner (SSID + signal strength) via Windows system commands
radarScan.li4: Animated radar display with a device list and their status

tetris.lede: Tetris in Tkinter, 120 FPS with a wide board (12×30).
tetris.li1: Render loop decoupled from the gravity loop (120 FPS display)
tetris.li3: Live score, level, and line count, with progressive drop speed

todoApp.li1: Add, edit, delete, and mark tasks as done

miniBrowser.desc: A mini web browser built in Python.

footer.tagline: Xenebia's workshop — personal projects, updated as they go
